title: Preserve caller failure contracts when hardening lower layers
summary: Security or durability hardening below an API must preserve the caller-visible distinction between safe refusal, ordinary failure and uncertain mutation.
problem_pattern: A lower-level helper becomes stricter and broad exception handling accidentally reclassifies pre-mutation failures as indeterminate or masks the original error.
failure_mode: Callers retry unsafe operations, stop on safe failures, or lose the real failure cause.
root_cause: The mutation boundary and descriptor/resource ownership are not explicit in the failure contract.
prevention_rule: Define the mutation point, transfer resource ownership explicitly, preserve original exceptions and mark uncertainty only after mutation may have occurred.
preflight_checks: separate pre-mutation refusal from post-mutation uncertainty
verify cleanup cannot mask the original exception
add regressions for both pre-write and post-write failure paths
applicability_notes: Generic for filesystem, ledger, API and external side-effect operations.
